2131-2173-4574-5330--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
2131-2173-4574-5330--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

360-1339-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
360-1339-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

728-7096--5.easyPrerequisites: You've had at least one land enter this turn.
728-7096--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6972-7782.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Clockwork Hydra.
When Clockwork Hydra dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6972-7782.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

390-670-1619-2665.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
390-670-1619-2665.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Hulking Metamorph and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
390-670-1619-2665.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3908-5361.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3908-5361.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Spark Double and Auton Soldier each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3908-5361.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

215-1115-1526.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
215-1115-1526.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Circle of Dreams Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Circle of Dreams Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1894-2173-5220-6772.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

140-1839-7433.description:
Activate Kuro by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

678-4027-4871.description:
Cast Glint Hawk by paying {W}.
When Glint Hawk enters, it triggers. Choose not to return an artifact to your hand, instead sacrificing Glint Hawk.
When Glint Hawk dies, Enduring Renewal and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Glint Hawk from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

4766-5231-7361.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more Spirits.
4766-5231-7361.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Kodama.
When Kodama dies, its soulshift ability and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Kodama from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat.

628-5147-7191.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bristlebane Battler.
When Bristlebane Battler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

1308-2506-4600-7150.description:
Cast Kirol either from your hand or the command zone by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

527-1409-5223.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-4885-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4644-5921-5970-6968.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1020-2866-6518-6967.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

973-5220-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Matter Reshaper
When Matter Reshaper dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Matter Reshaper from your graveyard onto the top of your library 
Resolve the Matter Reshaper trigger, revealing Matter Reshaper from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1358-3525-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
1358-3525-6788.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
1358-3525-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

913-3525-5149-5516.easyPrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
Power Artifact attached to Signpost Scarecrow.
913-3525-5149-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
913-3525-5149-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

997-1844-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Fateful Handoff.
997-1844-5434-5555.description:
Cast Fateful Handoff by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 2.

880-2783-4826.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-2783-4826.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control.
If the creature was a Dragon Egg, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the land enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

891-1585-2523-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies as a legendary creature due to In Bolas's Clutches, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Boonweaver Giant that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
When the Boonweaver Giant token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning In Bolas's Clutches from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

2061-2104-4477.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation each turn.
2061-2104-4477.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1344-1636-4161.notablePrerequisites:
Nested Ghoul does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Nested Ghoul indestructible.
1344-1636-4161.description:
Cast Brawl by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Give Nested Ghoul indestructible, if needed.
Activate Nested Ghoul by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to itself.
Nested Ghoul triggers, creating a 2/2 Phyrexian Zombie creature token.
When the Phyrexian Zombie enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 3.

1407-2615-5147.notablePrerequisites: You do not control a Construct.
1407-2615-5147.description:
Activate Dollhouse of Horrors by paying {1}, tapping it and exiling Tree of Perdition from your graveyard, creating a token copy of Tree of Perdition that is a 0/0 Construct with haste.
Activate the Tree of Perdition token by tapping it, swapping an opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Tree of Perdition token, dealing 1 damage to the opponent whose life total was swapped.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or les life.

2557-3209-4050-4871.description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying {4}{G}, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {1}{G}.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating four Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana, you may forego sacrificing the Saproling tokens.

350-1636-2519-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Llanowar Mentor does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
350-1636-2519-4050.description:
Cast Beck by paying {G}{U}, allowing you to draw a card whenever a creature enters the battlefield this turn.
Activate Llanowar Mentor by paying {G}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Llanowar Elves creature token.
The Llanowar Elves token enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm and Beck.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Beck trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Llanowar Elves token, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2104-3277-4305.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Izzet Chronarch.
2104-3277-4305.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Izzet Chronarch.
Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation to your hand.
Repeat.

64-4305-4872.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Warden of the Eye.
64-4305-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye.
The Warden of the Eye token enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
